g.text: Removing the long tail in 4:4:4 streaming
Before: mean 6.95 ms / p99 13.96 ms. Release: mean 6.08 ms / p99 7.09 ms.
K17 · 4K HDR · ~116 FPS · separate streams · first 30 s excluded · dashed line: 120 Hz frame period.
Host, network transit, scanout position and TV processing excluded. 8,467 / 8,453 matched frames; no recorded drops.
